items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: That's my sister Sadie... We worked together... You know... When they was together.

ctx.x: Yeah, Mabel was a great piano player. Mabel was a great piano player. And then, the next great piano player was Sadie. So Sadie, she living in Detroit, Michigan now. But she don't care for it much no more.
